values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the site page(s) for one night (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. note: A short gravel back-in (about 28 ft) under hardwoods beside Big Hollow Road, about 4.7 miles from Mill Creek Road. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs and its campsite map layer calls it a tent or small trailer/RV site; listed as 40 by 25 ft with 15 ft of overhead clearance. An easy approach for a forest road: Mill Creek Road from PA 87 near Hillsgrove, nothing over about 6%. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 496 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 30 ft, clearance 15 ft, back-in gravel 28 ft. Season changed to January-June (resting rotation); not on sale until 1 January. Fees confirmed, $6.50 fee added; pull_through false; facilities none. Imagery (leaf-off): a pale spur about 20 m long off the road ending at the pin; not moved. Access gentle (5.8% max over 1.2 km). NHD: Noon Branch 134 m, a small pond 108 m; not waterfront. Site 498 (15250) is 1.75 km away: separate entries are right.
flags: SEASON CHANGED year_round true -> opens 01-01, closes 06-30: DCNR's Loyalsock camping page rests every designated campsite for six months a year (even numbers open 1 January - 30 June, odd numbers 1 July - 31 December) and the booking calendar follows it to the day. The site page still says 'Status: Open year round'. January-March inside the open half is unplowed ('access is not guaranteed'). No status written: the July-December block is the stated rotation.

DCNR GIS layer (2022 record) describes the site as 'Wooded site adjacent to road. Tent or small trailer/RV'; the booking page lists RV Site and Trailer Site with the length written. 'Equipment: Although RVs, Camper Trailers and Tent (Pop-up) Trailers are allowed on this site, the site was not designed for such use and may not be appropriate for some equipment. Check site dimensions, site layout, and overhead clearance' (both in the note).

Access road: PA 87 near Hillsgrove > Mill Creek Road 2.9 mi > Big Hollow Road 4.7 mi (OSRM, matches the page). 3DEP: steepest 1.2 km 5.8% (Mill Creek Road), no run of 8%+. Well under the yardstick. Surfaces not confirmed.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront. NHD: Noon Branch (intermittent) 134 m; a small pond/swamp polygon 108 m, in woods.
